headline: A calm, honest listing-alert service, but it watches listings when what I wanted was to hear from people who live there, so it doesn't fix what actually burned me.
must_fix: Nothing from real residents: no tenant notes and no way to text someone who lives in the building. That's the one thing I'd have used. Without it this is just a smarter saved search.

It only matters while I'm actively hunting and racing for listings. For someone like me who already found a place without much drama, there's nothing to do with it, and nothing lets me give back by answering a few questions about my own building.
would_flip_me: Attach a few short, dated notes from current or past residents to each alerted building (plus the block it's on), and let me read them without an account, for free.
in_character_reaction: Okay so it's... alerts? Like StreetEasy alerts but nicer? Honestly that's not what I needed. Every tour was some sales guy, and I just wanted to text someone who actually lives there and ask how the laundry is. I like that it's not trying to hype me up or rush me, but if I'm filling out a whole brief to get notifications, I'd probably just let my mom handle it.
